question: What is the race of the superhero with maximum attribute value?
evidence: maximum attribute value refers to MAX(attribute_value);
clarification: If several rows tie at the cut-off, return all of them.
gold: SELECT c0 FROM (SELECT T3.race AS c0, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY T2.attribute_value DESC) AS __r FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN hero_attribute AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id INNER JOIN race AS T3 ON T1.race_id = T3.id) AS __t WHERE __r <= 1
gold0: SELECT T3.race FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN hero_attribute AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id INNER JOIN race AS T3 ON T1.race_id = T3.id ORDER BY T2.attribute_value DESC LIMIT 1

d.request: What are the races of all superheroes whose attribute value equals the maximum attribute value? Include every superhero tied for that maximum.
d.sql: SELECT DISTINCT s.superhero_name, r.race FROM hero_attribute AS ha JOIN superhero AS s ON s.id = ha.hero_id LEFT JOIN race AS r ON r.id = s.race_id WHERE ha.attribute_value = (SELECT MAX(attribute_value) FROM hero_attribute)

b.request: Return the race of every superhero whose attribute value equals the maximum `attribute_value` in `hero_attribute`, including all superheroes tied at that maximum
b.sql: SELECT r.race FROM superhero AS s LEFT JOIN race AS r ON r.id = s.race_id WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hero_attribute AS ha WHERE ha.hero_id = s.id AND ha.attribute_value = (SELECT MAX(attribute_value) FROM hero_attribute))

c.sql: SELECT r.race FROM hero_attribute AS ha JOIN superhero AS s ON s.id = ha.hero_id LEFT JOIN race AS r ON r.id = s.race_id WHERE ha.attribute_value = (SELECT MAX(attribute_value) FROM hero_attribute);
